name.fr-FR: De unione sacerdotis cum Christo (traduction anglaise)
name.en-US: The Priest in Union with Christ
name.pt-BR: O sacerdote em união com Cristo (tradução inglesa)

description.en-US: The priest’s union with Christ the Priest and Victim: the priesthood of Christ, the priest’s spiritual life, and his sanctification through the Mass, the divine office and prayer, from the author’s 1948 treatise. G. W. Shelton’s translation (Mercier Press, Cork 1951; Newman Press 1952).
description.pt-BR: A união do sacerdote com Cristo Sacerdote e Vítima: o sacerdócio de Cristo, a vida espiritual do sacerdote e sua santificação. Tradução inglesa de G. W. Shelton (Cork, 1951).

sources.edition: The Priest in Union with Christ, tr. G. W. Shelton, Cork: Mercier Press, 1951 (Westminster, Md.: Newman Press, 1952), archive.org Lagrange-English; the Latin original is not open
